speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To begin our consultation regarding your longstanding pruritic rash and the numbness/tingling on your palms, have you noticed any specific patterns to your rash, such as whether it appears on your hands, feet, or face?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease). The combination of a year-long pruritic rash on the upper body/face, bilateral numbness/tingling in the palms, and exposure to livestock/farm work is highly suggestive of leprosy. I am requesting a Skin Biopsy and a Skin Slit Smear for AFB staining to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Skin_Biopsy, Skin_Slit_Smear; REQUEST IMAGES: Lesion_Photos.
